review_notes: Solid source, transformer, MCC, charger, inverter, ATS, 120 VAC bus, and load chains were retained where direct named endpoints are visually connected.
Named buses are used as bus nodes; devices on a shared bus are connected to the bus rather than pairwise to each other.
Dashed/dotted/control paths are asserted only where the viewed crop shows a direct named endpoint-to-endpoint route; longer shared or crossing dashed paths remain uncertain.
The existing uncertain set is retained for PT-to-relay/annunciation, shared interlock, and ambiguous relay/TB/ESFAS paths.
